new_articles.title: Hyundai Motor Group to invest $15.5 billion in India in seven years
new_articles.summary: Hyundai Motor 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Hyundai Motor Group to invest $15.5 billion in India in seven years'이다. Hyundai Motor Group will invest $15. 5 billion in India by 2032 to expand manufacturing operations and R&D capabilities. This investment aims to strengthen the local automotive ecosystem while fostering partnerships with local suppliers. Additionally, the group will establish a dedicated investment entity in India to coordinate these efforts. The comprehensive investment is expected to create numerous job opportunities across various sectors. Through this investment, we will create more employment opportunities and work together with our partners and stakeholders to support India’s continued industrial development”, Euisun Chung, Executive Chair, Hyundai Motor Group said As part of the initiative to scale up its presence in the Indian market, HMG plans to expand manufacturing capacity across Hyundai Motor India and Kia India to support significant volume growth while ensuring localization to meet local market demands ” Hyundai additionally said it will strengthen local supply chain and support supplier development in India through strategic investments in regional partners You Might Also Like: India's festive car-buying joyride may hit price hike bump Hyundai Motor Group further said it aims to lead India's future mobility ecosystem through strategic investments in emerging opportunities Hyundai Motor Group said India is one of the world's fastest-growing automotive markets and “a critical platform” for its mid-to-long-term strategy.
